# Universal-driver contract corpus

`oracles.json` is a synthetic, normalized catalogue of the approved A01–A25
acceptance cases. It is **not captured provider output**, a parser, a lifecycle
reducer, or evidence that those behaviours pass. U01 checks its wire fidelity,
case inventory, identity domains, raw errors, ordered native input parts and
receipt distinctions. Later U02–U08 consumers must execute the actual behaviour
and the larger permutation/capability/client-server matrices.

The source reference and reviewed document-set hash in the file identify the
read-only design inputs. Titles retain historical incident names; the neutral
contracts contain no provider registry, text matcher or request-binding policy.

Each case includes explicitly synthetic baseline evidence and a reviewed oracle:
public state, input readiness, native-attempt disposition, retained request,
attention, and prohibition on uncertain input replay. A baseline that says
`covered_quiescent` is a supplied test premise, never inferred from missing
events or an empty composer. Override endpoint/capabilities are deliberate
negative cases. Surfaces are text-only examples, not authoritative styled-grid
captures; later driver tests must supply labelled producer-derived focus/cells.

Native records, transport receipts and source-read progress remain distinct.
Equal ID values in different namespaces cannot alias; incomplete trailing bytes
must survive without UTF-8 coercion; raw nested errors cannot become a string.
Optional native names, retryability and ordered cause chains remain facts, not
retry decisions. A native interruption and its cause do not prove operator stop.
An enqueued/written stop operation is not native completion. Callback absence
does not downgrade a declared lifecycle capability to absent.

Budget metadata records required future oracles, not an implemented scheduler:
durable pre-dispatch reservations, fixed first-failure window, zero-byte rejection
counting, and no callback/restart renewal. The trusted-reset exception, all crash
boundaries, old-client/new-server paths and all manifest capability combinations
remain part of the reviewed acceptance matrix for their behavioural PRs.

No fixture loads a real provider home, credential, live Bus socket or external
transcript. Do not replace synthetic provenance with a claim of real acceptance.
